description: Dependencies no import expresses: a test that spawns the CLI, a test that reads a template with fs, a snapshot file, an import.meta.glob plugin loader, and a toolchain pin. Regressions from running depwave on Vite and tRPC.

scenarios.name: source-change-via-spawn
scenarios.description: cli.test.ts runs src/index.ts as a process: it may run any file of its package.

scenarios.name: template-data-change
scenarios.description: A JSON template no code imports, read by a test with fs: every test of its package runs.

scenarios.name: snapshot-change
scenarios.description: A snapshot maps to exactly its own test.

scenarios.name: glob-plugin-change
scenarios.description: import.meta.glob('./builtin/*.ts') loads a.ts; the spawning cli.test also covers the package.

scenarios.name: toolchain-pin
scenarios.description: A Node version bump changes the environment of every test.

scenarios.name: docs-change
scenarios.description: Documentation outside test-data directories selects nothing.

scenarios.name: other-package-change
scenarios.description: The spawning test's wildcard is scoped to its own package.
